H5329: properly, to glitter from afar, i.e. to be eminent (as a superintendent, especially of the Temple services and its music); to be permanent
H1121: a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense (of literal and figurative relationship, including grandson, subject, nation, quality or condition, etc., (like father or brother), etc.)
H7141: Korach, the name of two Edomites and three Israelites
H5921: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
H5961: properly, girls, i.e. the soprano or female voice, perhaps falsetto
H430: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus, especially with the article) of the supreme God; occasionally applied by way of deference to magistrates; and sometimes as a superlative
H5797: strength in various applications (force, security, majesty, praise)
H6869: tightness (i.e. figuratively, trouble); transitively, a female rival:
H4672: properly, to come forth to, i.e. appear or exist; transitively, to attain, i.e. find or acquire; figuratively, to occur, meet or be present
H3966: properly, vehemence, i.e. (with or without preposition) vehemently; by implication, wholly, speedily, etc. (often with other words as an intensive or superlative; especially when repeated)
H3651: properly, set upright; hence (figuratively as adjective) just; but usually (as adverb or conjunction) rightly or so (in various applications to manner, time and relation; often with other particles)
H3808: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
H3372: to fear; morally, to revere; caus. to frighten
H4171: to alter; by implication, to barter, to dispose of
H776: the earth (at large, or partitively a land)
H4131: to waver; by implication, to slip, shake, fall
H2022: a mountain or range of hills (sometimes used figuratively)
H3820: the heart; also used (figuratively) very widely for the feelings, the will and even the intellect; likewise for the centre of anything
H3220: a sea (as breaking in noisy surf) or large body of water; specifically (with the article), the Mediterranean Sea; sometimes a large river, or an artifical basin; locally, the west, or (rarely) the south
H1993: to make a loud sound (like English 'hum'); by implication, to be in great commotion or tumult, to rage, war, moan, clamor
H2560: properly, to boil up; hence, to ferment (with scum); to glow (with redness); to smear with pitch
H4325: water; figuratively, juice; by euphemism, urine, semen
H7493: to undulate (as the earth, the sky, etc.; also a field of grain), particularly through fear; specifically, to spring (as a locust)
H1346: arrogance or majesty; by implication, (concretely) ornament
H5104: a stream (including the sea; expectation the Nile, Euphrates, etc.); figuratively, prosperity
H6388: a rill (i.e. small channel of water, as in irrigation)
H8055: probably to brighten up, i.e. (figuratively) be (causatively, make) blithe or gleesome
H5892: a city (a place guarded by waking or a watch) in the widest sense (even of a mere encampment or post)
H6918: sacred (ceremonially or morally); (as noun) God (by eminence), an angel, a saint, a sanctuary
H4908: a residence (including a shepherd's hut, the lair of animals, figuratively, the grave; also the Temple); specifically, the Tabernacle (properly, its wooden walls)
H5945: an elevation, i.e. (adj.) lofty (compar.); as title, the Supreme
H7130: properly, the nearest part, i.e. the center, whether literal, figurative or adverbial (especially with preposition)
H1077: properly, a failure; by implication nothing; usually (adverb) not at all; also lest
H5826: to surround, i.e. protect or aid
H6437: to turn; by implication, to face, i.e. appear, look, etc.
H1242: properly, dawn (as the break of day); generally, morning
H1471: a foreign nation; hence, a Gentile; also (figuratively) a troop of animals, or a flight of locusts
H4467: dominion, i.e. (abstractly) the estate (rule) or (concretely) the country (realm)
H5414: to give, used with greatest latitude of application (put, make, etc.)
H4127: to melt, i.e. literally (to soften, flow down, disappear), or figuratively (to fear, faint)
H3068: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
H6635: a mass of persons (or figuratively, things), especially reg. organized forwar (an army); by implication, a campaign, literally or figuratively (specifically, hardship, worship)
H5973: adverb or preposition, with (i.e. in conjunction with), in varied applications; specifically, equally with; often with prepositional prefix (and then usually unrepresented in English)
H4869: defence, high fort (tower), refuge, Misgab, a place in Moab
H3212: to walk (literally or figuratively); causatively, to carry (in various senses)
H2372: to gaze at; mentally to perceive, contemplate (with pleasure); specifically, to have avision of
H834: who, which, what, that; also (as an adverb and a conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc.
H7760: to put (used in a great variety of applications, literal, figurative, inferentially, and elliptically)
H7673: to repose, i.e. desist from exertion; used in many implied relations (causative, figurative or specific)
H4421: a battle (i.e. the engagement); generally, war (i.e. warfare)
H5704: as far (or long, or much) as, whether of space (even unto) or time (during, while, until) or degree (equally with)
H7198: a bow, forshooting (hence, figuratively, strength) or the iris
H2595: a lance (for thrusting, like pitching a tent)
H5699: something revolving, i.e. a wheeled vehicle
H7503: to slacken (in many applications, literal or figurative)
H3045: to know (properly, to ascertain by seeing); used in a great variety of senses, figuratively, literally, euphemistically and inferentially (including observation, care, recognition; and causatively, instruction, designation, punishment, etc.)
H3588: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
H7311: to be high actively, to rise or raise (in various applications, literally or figuratively)
